name: kockpit-__DOMAIN__-ingestion
comment: One monitor per domain given with --ingestion DOMAIN:MINUTES; pick domains with steady traffic, others can be silent for hours. Date math (now-30m, {{period_end}}||-30m) matched nothing inside monitors on OpenSearch 3.2, so the trigger compares the newest start with the check time instead.

triggers.name: No __DOMAIN__ audit indexed for __MAX_LAG__ minutes
triggers.script: def r = ctx.results[0]; def v = r.aggregations.last.value; if (v == null) { r.stopped = 'no __DOMAIN__ audit at all in __DOMAIN__-__INDEX__-__ENV__-read'; return true; } long lag = (ctx.periodEnd.toEpochMilli() - (long) v) / 60000L; r.stopped = 'newest __DOMAIN__ audit is ' + lag + ' min old (' + r.aggregations.last.value_as_string + ')'; return lag >= __MAX_LAG__;
